en.hubeali:
From him, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, 
(It has been narrated) from the one who heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘The one who restrains his anger, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Veil his bareness’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Sayf ibn ‘ Amirah from the one who had heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying:
“Whoever controls his anger, Allah covers his defects for him. ’”
